$description: Dark Mode semantic token overrides. Implements intentional layered luminance stepping (not raw mathematical color inversion) to guarantee surface depth, border definition, and WCAG AA/AAA text contrast.

raised.$description: Elevated dark container and floating card background (#1E293B)

overlay.$description: Modal dialog, popover, and drawer surface in dark mode (#334155)

primary.$description: High-contrast text on dark surfaces (#FFFFFF, 14.5:1 against neutral.900)

secondary.$description: Secondary muted text on dark surfaces (#94A3B8, 5.2:1 against neutral.900)

inverse.$description: Inverted dark text on bright brand accent buttons (#0F172A)

subtle.$description: Subtle border and divider in dark mode (#1E293B)

default.$description: Standard border for dark mode interactive controls (#334155)
